svg.text: item-0001.js … item-1000.js, written four different ways
about 38k tokens of files: more than the window
Write a test and run it
the rule, one test file, one result
The dashed line is where compaction starts (16k of 32k).
The agent cannot look at 1000 files, but it can write code that does. Point it at the rule in prices/README.md and ask for one test that imports
every file and compares gross() with the price the rule gives. If it starts reading the files one by one, stop it (ctrl+c) and ask for the test.
